name: Runtime NaN/Inf nested in a composite write — Go/Java/C++ byte-exact
description: Issue #210. A Lua table whose element overflows to +Inf (item_score defaults to float64 max, then * 2) used to pass the write-time check because only scalars were inspected: pine-go then failed to encode the response, pine-java emitted a quoted "Infinity" and pine-cpp emitted bare inf (invalid JSON). apply_output now scans composites and rejects them with the scalar message, so all three runtimes fail at the same write with the same bytes. The row that overflows is item[0] (item_score null -> default).

expected_error.wrapping_exact: pine: execution error in operator "overflow_in_table": item[0] write: field "item_result": NaN/Inf is not a valid JSON value
